instructions: Stand upright, step one leg forward and lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Push back to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Stand holding dumbbells with a slight bend in the knees.
Hinge at the hips and lower the weights while keeping a neutral spine, then return upright.
Stand tall and raise your heels off the floor, then slowly lower them back down.
Stand on the middle of a resistance band and curl the handles upward, keeping elbows at your sides.
Lower with control back to the starting position.
Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend back up.
